families.semantics: GET capabilities uses authenticated action=list and caller-filtered registry records. Provider-specific authenticated_discovery and registry.summary are supporting diagnostics, not the universal catalogue. Canonical system.registry.list execution exposure must be reconciled with the route.
unresolved_capabilities: Universal canonical registry operation/HTTP/MCP discovery equivalence and current caller-filtered executability evidence.

families.semantics: GET capabilities/{operation} uses action=describe for the selected operation. Provider discovery is not a universal schema/handler/grant description; reconcile canonical system.registry.describe with this builtin route.
unresolved_capabilities: Universal canonical describe operation/HTTP/MCP equivalence for schema, handler, prerequisites and grants.

families.semantics: Generic operations/{operation}:execute dispatches the selected existing operation contract through shared admission, not a separate provider executor. Durable enqueue and legacy deployment execution are distinct acceptance cases; approve_read is authorization support, not execution.
unresolved_capabilities: Cross-operation synchronous/asynchronous lifecycle and principal/tenant equivalence through the shared gateway.

families.semantics: Job route classification uses authenticated database resolution to distinguish durable orchestration.jobs.get from legacy deployment.jobs.get. Execution receipt lookup is system.execution.get; deployment.jobs.status is a compatibility diagnostic, not assumed identical without contract tests.
unresolved_capabilities: Durable and legacy job/provider-request/result readback under all supported principals.

families.semantics: Events use orchestration.jobs.events or deployment.jobs.events after principal-scoped job classification. Cursor pagination and ordering must preserve job isolation; polling records alone do not prove streaming delivery.
unresolved_capabilities: Structured event ordering/resume/delivery and cancellation interaction across supported job kinds.

families.semantics: Cancel routes to the actual durable/legacy job kind. Eligible state transitions, worker cancellation acknowledgement and prevention of further effects are separate from request acceptance; cancel is not forced provider rollback.
unresolved_capabilities: Actual eligible running-worker/provider cancellation outcome and negative/recovery cases.

families.semantics: Retry routes to the actual job kind and only idempotent failed work. Unknown provider effects must reconcile first; a fresh job or changed contract/input cannot inherit retry authority.
unresolved_capabilities: Failed-step idempotency, changed-contract refusal and uncertain-outcome reconciliation across supported operations.

families.semantics: Rollback routes to system.lifecycle.compensate with exact compensation approval and server-selected source snapshot. Lifecycle get/verify are required readbacks; engineering.rollback.* prepares source recovery but is not universal production compensation.
unresolved_capabilities: General approved production compensation and independent postcondition/rollback verification; fixture rollback is insufficient.

families.semantics: Audit list/verify/checkpoint cover chain integrity and observation. Current HTTP resource filter is treated as an operation ID, not arbitrary target-resource lookup. Resource-indexed audit and retention/access behavior remain requirements.
unresolved_capabilities: Actual target-resource audit filtering, access/retention and independent chain verification.

families.semantics: Current plans.validate accepts bounded read-only DAGs and reports provider_dry_run_performed=false, null monetary cost and no tenant execution. Schema/dependency validation is not general provider dry-run, pricing or mutation blast-radius planning.
unresolved_capabilities: General authorized provider dry-run, monetary cost and mutation blast-radius planning beyond the current read-only validator.

families.semantics: plans.execute records a bounded DAG and plans.get observes its jobs; accepted is not completed. Current read-only owner scope does not implement arbitrary multi-service mutation graphs or tenant execution. Runtime owns shared scheduler/worker orchestration.
unresolved_capabilities: General authorized multi-service mutation DAG, partial failure/compensation and tenant execution beyond the current read-only engine.
